output:
**What I found:** The line-limit gate looks green, but it no longer checks anything. Each time it goes red, a script rewrites the baseline to match the current tree, so the exception list grew from 41 to 58 modules in 12 days without anyone deciding to add an entry. The fix is to let the baseline shrink on its own and grow only when a change names the new entry (the record calls this RATCHET). What decided it: 34 rewrites, 17 new entries, and no commit message that mentions any of them.

**Why it matters:** As things stand, any module can go over the limit without anyone deciding it should, and the green check hides that. Turning the ratchet on will turn the gate red on in-flight PRs until someone either fixes or names each of the 17 new entries.

**Do this first:**
1. Replace the regenerate script with a reconcile step (algorithm in `.claude/skills/gate-lifecycle/references/ratchet.md`). It compares the baseline with the current tree. A new or grown entry fails the gate unless the change names it, e.g. `--accept-growth <path>` with a reason in the commit. Shrunk or stale entries are removed automatically. A red run writes nothing. Commit a unit test for the "refused" case and run it in CI. That test is the gate's negative control.
2. Rebuild the baseline from the 41-entry version from 12 days ago. Bring back each of the 17 additions in one change that names it with a reason, or fix the module instead. Drop any of the original 41 that are now under the limit.
3. Name an owner for the exception list. I don't know who that should be. You decide.

**What I did not check:**
- This workspace holds no repository, gate config, script or baseline, so none of this was run against real files.
- I don't know whether the baseline stores line counts per module or only names. If it stores counts, entries that were already in the list may also have grown. To check, diff the baseline from 12 days ago with today's: `git diff <commit-12-days-ago> HEAD -- <baseline.json>`.
- I don't know whether CI can push baseline changes on its own. Check the regenerate script's call sites and the pipeline's write permissions.

```text
Gate:         source-module line limit + JSON exception baseline, merge gate
Stage:        unplaced (merge gate; stage not given)
Trigger:      churn
Proof:        UNPROVEN (34 red runs exist but were erased by regeneration; no committed negative control)
Scope:        declared all source modules / effective modules not in a baseline regenerated from the current tree / delta every module over the limit after regeneration is no longer checked
Baseline:     58 entries, trend +17 in 12 days over 34 rewrites; last accepted growth: none named
Status:       BLOCKING (nominal; effectively non-blocking)
Decision:     RATCHET
Guard:        unnamed growth refused by reconcile; red run writes nothing; owner TBD (user to assign)
Handoff:      none
Next action:  replace the regenerate script with reconcile plus per-entry --accept-growth, and add the refused-case test to CI
Verification: Not run (no repository or gate files in this workspace)
```
